Two NHS-ester groups (lysine-reactive) + isotope-labelable spacer + cleavable site + biotin tag. Could not independently verify the exact monoisotopic bridge mass from publicly accessible text (not in abstract/review summaries) - needs the eLife 2016 paper's supplementary structural diagrams/mass calculations (should be open access).

Our current xi_class system (SymetricSingleAminoAcidRestrictedCrossLinker / AsymetricSingleAminoAcidRestrictedCrossLinker) and XiConfigGenerator only model amino-acid <-> amino-acid bridges - there is no existing support for an amino-acid <-> nucleotide target. Needs a human decision on whether/how to model this before merging.
